content: Equal-Cost Multi-Path (ECMP) routing for Azure Virtual Network is now available in public preview, enabling customers to distribute traffic across multiple network appliances using a single user-defined route (UDR). Customers can configure 2 to 16 next-hop IP addresses per route, scaling aggregate network throughput beyond individual appliance limits without increasing routing complexity. This capability supports bandwidth-intensive AI workloads, large-scale data platforms, and enterprise hub-and-spoke architectures. Learn more.
